cover_letter_text:
Hi Contrive Consultants team,

My name's Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to start out as a civil draftsperson. Your careers page says the drawings go into real council submissions, with senior review on everything, so I wanted to apply.

During the course I prepared civil drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D for roads, earthworks and stormwater drainage, and designed around existing services after lodging Before You Dig Australia enquiries. On site in the Philippines I reviewed drawings and checked work against the plans.

I will relocate to Sydney for this role and can start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
advert_text:
Civil Draftsperson
Contrive Consultants - Civil & Stormwater
Bella Vista, Sydney NSW
Full-time
AutoCAD or QCAD experience essential

Draft civil and stormwater packages - drainage layouts, OSD details, sediment control plans, road and pavement design - for developments across NSW.

This is a hands-on drafting role in a busy civil and stormwater team. AutoCAD or QCAD experience is essential. If you have drafted stormwater or civil plans before you will go to the top of the list, but we will also consider strong drafters from an adjacent field who want to move into civil.

What you will be doing
- Produce stormwater drainage layouts, longitudinal sections and pit and pipe schedules
- Draft on-site detention (OSD) tank details, outlet structures and rainwater reuse arrangements
- Prepare erosion and sediment control plans and construction detail sheets
- Draft road, pavement, kerb and driveway profiles to council and Austroads standards
- Set up and maintain drawing sheets, title blocks and CAD standards
- Incorporate survey data and mark-ups from design engineers into drawing sets

What we are looking for
- Demonstrated AutoCAD or QCAD experience - this is mandatory for the role
- Ability to work accurately from engineers’ mark-ups and redlines
- Understanding of drawing conventions, scales, levels and annotation
- Attention to detail and a methodical approach to revisions and issue control
- Valid working rights in Australia

Nice to have
- Previous stormwater or civil plan drafting - strongly preferred
- Civil 3D, 12d Model or Civil Site Design experience
- Familiarity with NSW council engineering specifications and works-as-executed drawings
- Exposure to DRAINS or MUSIC output and how it feeds a drawing set

The careers page lists this role as one of three full-time positions based at the Bella Vista office. Applications are sent through the careers page form (a resume is required). Overseas qualifications are welcome. The page also notes early-career work is checked and marked up, and that drawings and reports go into real council submissions.
